intro: Singapore is a global hub for shipping, finance and technology, and one of the richest countries per person.

chapters.title: A global hub
text: Its port is one of the busiest in the world, and Changi Airport is often voted the world's best. Banks, chip factories and oil refineries make it an economic powerhouse.

chapters.title: Water
text: Singapore buys water from Malaysia, collects rainwater, desalinates seawater and recycles wastewater into 'NEWater'.

keyTerms.meaning: A trading port where goods are imported and re-exported.

cardGroups.title: Made in Singapore
cardGroups.intro: Some of the things Singapore makes and sells to the world.
